name: plan-p4-equipment-first-otr
about: A planned campaign (V2c, prompt v5): the P4 starter preset written from the idea the Strategist recorded for "otr-many-facts" — the newer truck, on a job with seven facts to choose from. Every candidate should lead with the idea and state only the brief's facts. The brief is that fixture's with "no-touch freight" and "pets allowed" as facts, where a real opening puts a listed benefit (openingSubjectMatter): as job details the copy may only quote them whole, and the first recording was refused for rewording them.

area.label: Fixture Yard, IL
area.reason: Fixture: drivers within a day's drive of the yard.

subject_matter.in_our_words: Family owned, and the owner still drives

recipe.name: Walk-around
recipe.hook_formula: Point at the equipment: what the driver will actually drive or haul, as the brief describes it (the trailer type, the freight). If the brief says nothing about the equipment, lead with the freight or the kind of run. Then the strongest fact the brief states.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our tractor parked at {setting}, {viewpoint}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

angle.idea: Lead with the newer truck, parked and clean with the reefer trailer hooked up.
angle.proof: The job lists newer trucks and reefer freight.
